subject: Private Offer MAP & procurement runway — Cobalt Health (GCP)
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cobalthealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@cobalthealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Cobalt Health MAP for GCP private offer

Hi Priyom / Karthik —

Thanks for the demo last week. We lined up execs internally and they want to move forward with a GCP private offer, but need a tight MAP and clear procurement milestones so Finance and Legal can sign off. High-level asks from our side:

- Draft private-offer terms and billing routing (GCP Marketplace)
- Completion checklist for procurement (SOC2 evidence, network docs, KMS notes)
- Targeted close date: end of June (we may accelerate)

I attached a short intake spreadsheet with our dates (Cobalt_MAP_v1.xlsx). Can you propose a mutual action plan with owner-level tasks so I can share with our procurement lead (cc'd)?

Also include any expected blocker items (billing contact, billing PO flow, ingestion limits).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we want an internal review by Wed.

Best,
Alex
Director of Platform Ops
Cobalt Health

Attachment: Cobalt_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Cobalt Health MAP for GCP private offer

Hi Alex —

Thanks — this is great context. I pulled together an initial mutual action plan and attached a draft private-offer summary and checklist (GCP_PrivateOffer_Draft.pdf). Key notes up front:

1) Close target: 2029-06-28 (we backed out weekend; can tighten to 6/21 if procurement moves fast)
2) Billing path: we recommend GCP Private Offer with invoice via your billing contact; Redwood can accept invoice terms and route to your billing account (need billing account ID + PO).
3) Compliance items: SOC 2 Type II report (we can provide a redacted copy), architecture diagram for our Private control plane, KMS/HSM integration notes.

Proposed owners:
- Redwood (Priyom): finalize private-offer draft, provide SOC2 & network doc
- Redwood (Karthik): technical acceptance checklist and model performance SLA notes
- Cobalt (Alex / Procurement): confirm billing account ID, procurement approval gates, and PO cadence

Can we schedule a 30-min working session tomorrow 10:00-10:30 PT to walk the MAP and owners?

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: GCP_PrivateOffer_Draft.pdf (summary), Cobalt_MAP_v1.xlsx (ref)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Cobalt MAP — tech acceptance & billing notes

Team —

Looping in Laura (CS onboarding) and Grace (Finance) for quick alignment. Quick points I want us to confirm before the working session with Cobalt:

- Acceptance criteria (technical):
  * test set: 3 production prompts + latency under 450ms p50 on (n=100)
  * data residency: US GCP region (us-central1)
  * KV cache warmup plan for initial ramp up

- Billing / commercial:
  * Confirm we can set billing to invoice monthly to Cobalt's GCP billing account (Grace: will this require any internal billing flow changes?)
  * Discounts: proposed 18% on list for first 12 months in the draft (Priyom — pls review)

Laura — I'll need your onboarding timeline to include acceptance gates so procurement sees clear milestones. Grace — any flags on PO routing to Marketplace?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Platform Solutions

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Cobalt Health MAP for GCP private offer

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the intake. From an onboarding/acceptance perspective here's a compact milestone plan (I'll add to the MAP spreadsheet):

Milestone A — Sandbox Eval (owner: Redwood / Karthik) — target by 2029-06-03
  * 2-week sandbox access
  * success criteria: pass perf & quality baseline, share evaluation report
Milestone B — Legal & Procurement Acceptance (owner: Cobalt / Alex) — target by 2029-06-14
  * sign private-offer terms in DocuSign (we'll provide a link)
Milestone C — Production Activation (owner: Redwood / Laura) — target by 2029-06-28
  * migrate traffic behind private control plane, validate billing, and close PO

Open items for your procurement team:
- Confirm billing account ID and PO cadence
- SOC2 access window (we can provide redacted reports by request)
- Data retention SLA language — do you need custom wording?

I'll join the working session tomorrow. Priyom — can you upload the MAP_v1 with these milestones to the Drive link and share?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-sample.docx (template)

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cobalthealth.com>

Date: Fri, 24 May 2029 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Cobalt Health MAP for GCP private offer — aligned

Thanks everyone — quick update from procurement/finance side after our internal review:

- Procurement confirmed PO cadence = monthly; Billing account ID: gcp-cobalt-009 (attached).
- Finance approved the 18% first-year concession but asked for a short-term SLA credit clause (we can accept up to 6 hours maintenance window without credit).
- We reviewed the MAP spreadsheet and are good with Milestone A/B/C and dates (Cobalt_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Next steps (agreed):
1) Priyom: upload final MAP to Drive and create DocuSign template for private offer (requested by Legal) — target 5/28
2) Karthik: publish sandbox invite + test prompts by 5/31
3) Laura: readiness checklist for production cutover by 6/25

I'll route DocuSign once I have the final PDF. Thanks all — aiming to hit 6/28 production activation.

Best,
Alex Moreno
Director of Platform Ops, Cobalt Health
